other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of the state
The scheme is open to all communities
At least 10 couples must participate in the mass marriage ceremony
Age of the bride must be at least 18 years
Age of the groom must be at least 21 years
benefits_summary: Each couple receives a total benefit of Rs 51,000, including Rs 35,000 deposited for the bride and additional funds for wedding expenses.
